items.title: Guest access policy - document sites
items.body: External guests may access a restricted site only if (a) their organisation is an approved vendor in the vendor register with an unexpired data processing agreement (DPA), (b) the permission carries a justification and an expiry date that has not passed, and (c) the address is not on a personal email domain. Links with scope "anyone" are not permitted on restricted sites. A restricted site with no approved guests must have external sharing switched off. Internal sites and public sites are out of ... (trimmed)

items.notes: Domain northaudit.example. Blocked 2026-09-01 after a data breach at the vendor; statutory audit moved to Keystone Audit.
